name: Eslam Badr
bio: Eslam Badr earned his PhD from UAB before joining AUC. His work focuses on algebraic geometry and arithmetic, including plane curves, moduli spaces, automorphism groups, twisting theory, quadratic points, and Weierstrass points.

name: Kate Ellis
bio: Kate Ellis is an associate professor and clinical psychologist at AUC. Her work focuses on refugees, trauma, youth exposed to violence, and accessible mental health interventions for conflict-affected communities.

name: Aya Musmar
bio: Aya Musmar is an assistant professor of humanities in architecture at AUC. Her work focuses on forced displacement, refugee camps, injustice, climate change, heritage, and architecture as a form of testimony.

name: Tamir El-Khouly
bio: Tamir El-Khouly earned his PhD in the built environment from UCL before joining AUC. His work focuses on architectural computing, BIM, machine learning, design thinking, and parametric design.

name: Wael El Mahallawy
bio: Wael El Mahallawy is an associate professor and music program director at AUC. His work focuses on Arab music theory, qanoun performance, sound engineering, and music technology.

name: Addison Ellis
bio: Addison Ellis earned his PhD from the University of Illinois before joining AUC. His work focuses on Kant, post-Kantian philosophy, Heidegger, self-consciousness, and spontaneity.

name: Daoud Siniora
bio: Daoud Siniora is an assistant professor of mathematics at AUC. His work focuses on pure mathematics, model theory, and mathematical logic.

name: Tamer El-Leithy
bio: Tamer El-Leithy studied economics and philosophy at AUC before specializing in medieval history. His work focuses on Coptic conversion, Arabization, and religious change in medieval Egypt.

name: Peter Barsoum
bio: Peter Barsoum has lived, studied, and taught across Southeast Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. He most recently taught writing at Samarkand State University in Uzbekistan.

name: Maha Bali
bio: Maha Bali earned her PhD in education from the University of Sheffield before joining AUC. Her work focuses on equitable, open, and connected learning, academic inclusion, and community-building.

name: Mohamed Aly
bio: Mohamed Fawzy Aly earned his PhD in mechanical engineering from McMaster University before joining AUC in 2010. His work focuses on advanced manufacturing, design optimization, and topology optimization.

name: Karim Banawan
bio: Karim A. Banawan earned his PhD in electrical engineering from the University of Maryland before joining AUC. His work focuses on information theory, wireless communications, network security, private information retrieval, and machine learning.

name: Karim Seddik
bio: Karim G. Seddik earned his PhD in electrical engineering from the University of Maryland before joining AUC. His work focuses on machine learning, wireless networks, intelligent reflecting surfaces, and backscatter communications.

name: Suher Zada
bio: Suher Zada is a professor of biology and immunology at AUC. Her work focuses on infectious diseases and immune-system research using biotechnology, nanotechnology, and computational methods.

name: Karim Addas
bio: Karim Addas earned his PhD in physics from Indiana University before joining AUC. His work focuses on microrheology and the behavior of semiflexible biological materials.

name: Tamer ElBatt
bio: Tamer ElBatt earned his PhD in electronics and communications engineering from the University of Maryland before joining AUC. His work focuses on wireless, mobile, and IoT networks.

name: Hani Henry
bio: Hani Henry earned his PhD in clinical psychology from Miami University before joining AUC. His work focuses on culture, marginalized communities, psychotherapy, counseling, and cross-cultural psychology.

name: Yasmine Motawy
bio: Yasmine Motawy teaches rhetoric and composition at AUC. Her work focuses on children’s literature, translation, criticism, editing, and contemporary Egyptian society.

name: Catarina Belo
bio: Catarina Belo is an associate professor of philosophy at AUC. Her work focuses on Islamic philosophy, medieval Christian thought, Hegel, religion, and virtue ethics.

name: Yasmine Ahmed
bio: Yasmine Moataz Ahmed earned her PhD in social anthropology from the University of Cambridge before joining AUC. Her work focuses on the state, citizenship, rural Egypt, agriculture, environment, and labor.

name: Salah Al-Agha
bio: Salah Al-Agha earned his MSc and PhD from Purdue University after completing his BSc at AUC. His work focuses on operations research, decision-making, lean practices, simulation, and engineering education.

name: Richard Fincham
bio: Richard Fincham earned his PhD from the University of Warwick before joining AUC. His work focuses on Kant, German philosophy, Humean skepticism, and transcendental idealism.

name: Ehab ElSawy
bio: Ehab El Sawy earned his PhD in physical chemistry at the University of Calgary before joining AUC in 2017. His work focuses on nano-electrochemistry, fuel cells, hydrogen production, batteries, sensors, and corrosion protection.

name: Nageh Allam
bio: Nageh Allam earned his PhD in materials science and engineering from Penn State before joining AUC in 2011. His work focuses on nanomaterials for energy, sensors, desalination, biomaterials, and computational materials science.

name: Tamer Shoeib
bio: Tamer Shoeib earned his PhD in chemistry from York University before conducting postdoctoral research in Canada. His work focuses on analytical and biophysical chemistry, molecular structure, mass spectrometry, and metal-containing biomolecules.

name: Hassan Azazy
bio: Hassan Azzazy earned his PhD from the University of North Texas Health Science Center before joining AUC. His work focuses on diagnostics, biosensors, nanobiotechnology, drug delivery, and clinical laboratory medicine.

name: Ibrahim Abotaleb
bio: Ibrahim Abotaleb earned his PhD from the University of Tennessee before joining AUC. His work focuses on AI in construction, sustainability, project control, risk, optimization, and contract management.

name: Arthur Bos
bio: Arthur Bos earned his PhD in coastal zone management and fish biology from Hamburg University before joining AUC in 2011. His work focuses on reef fish, marine protected areas, invertebrates, seagrass ecology, and habitat restoration.

name: Walid Fouad
bio: Walid Fouad earned his PhD in plant molecular and cellular biology from the University of Florida before joining AUC. His work focuses on plant biotechnology, crop improvement, stress tolerance, algae, biofuels, and sustainable agriculture.

name: Mohamed Badran
bio: Mohamed Badran earned his PhD in engineering systems and computing from the University of Guelph before joining AUC. His work focuses on operations research, optimization, autonomous vehicles, and BioMEMS sensors and actuators.

name: Ahmed Abdellatif
bio: Ahmed Abdellatif earned his MSc and PhD in anatomical sciences and neurobiology from the University of Louisville before joining AUC. His work focuses on tissue repair, diabetes, aging, dementia, and neurodegenerative diseases.

name: Wafik Lotfallah
bio: Wafik Lotfallah earned his PhD from the University of Wisconsin-Madison before joining AUC in 2009. His work focuses on finite model theory, descriptive complexity, fuzzy logic, and mathematical modeling.

name: Laila ElSerty
bio: Laila ElSerty earned her MA in TEFL from AUC and is pursuing a PhD in discourse analysis. Her work focuses on academic writing, linguistics, curriculum design, and teacher training.

name: Mariah Fairley
bio: Mariah J. Fairley is an English language educator with over 20 years of experience. Her work focuses on social justice, humanizing pedagogy, academic writing, identity, and TESOL.

name: Gretchen McCullough
bio: Gretchen McCullough earned her MFA in creative writing from the University of Alabama. Her work focuses on fiction, essays, literary translation, and expatriate life in Cairo.

name: Kathleen Saville
bio: Kathleen Saville is a senior instructor and department chair at AUC. Her work focuses on writing, curriculum development, teacher education, adult literacy, and creative nonfiction.

name: Fikry Boutros
bio: Fikry Boutros earned his PhD in TESOL from the University of Nicosia before joining AUC. His work focuses on second-language pragmatics, politeness, apologies, and email communication.

name: Nadine Abdalla
bio: Nadine Abdalla earned her PhD in political science from Sciences Po Grenoble before joining AUC. Her work focuses on social movements, state-society relations, local politics, and democracy in the MENA region.

name: Wael Abdallah
bio: Wael Abdallah earned his PhD from the University of Salford before joining AUC. His work focuses on corporate finance, investment, banking, international finance, and credit risk.

name: Mohamed Abdallah
bio: Mohamed Abdallah earned his PhD in environmental engineering from the University of Ottawa. His work focuses on waste management, waste-to-energy, sustainability, life-cycle assessment, and AI applications.

name: Sherif Abdel Azeem
bio: Sherif Abdel Azeem earned his PhD in electrical and computer engineering from Queen’s University before joining AUC. His work focuses on pattern recognition, OCR, and Arabic handwriting recognition.

name: Omar Abdelaziz
bio: Omar Abdelaziz earned his PhD in mechanical engineering from the University of Maryland. His work focuses on thermofluids, energy-efficient buildings, sustainable energy, HVAC&R, and low-GWP refrigerants.

name: Amr Abdelkawi
bio: Amr Abdelkawi studied architecture in the United States before joining AUC in 2010. His work focuses on architecture, design management, furniture, publishing, and vocational education.

name: Ahmed Abdelmeguid
bio: Ahmed Abdel-Meguid earned his PhD in accounting from Syracuse University before joining AUC. His work focuses on auditing, audit quality, corporate governance, and earnings quality.

name: Sherif Abdelmohsen
bio: Sherif Morad Abdelmohsen earned his PhD in architecture from Georgia Tech before joining AUC. His work focuses on computational design, digital fabrication, robotics, BIM, and virtual reality.

name: Anwar Abd ElNaser
bio: Anwar Abd ElNaser earned his MSc and PhD from the University of Alberta before joining AUC. His work focuses on hepatic and cardiovascular clinical chemistry and biomedical research.

name: Dalal Abo El Seoud
bio: Dalal Abo El Seoud earned her PhD from Ain Shams University and has taught at AUC since 1997. Her work focuses on teaching Arabic as a foreign language, oral skills, vocabulary, and Arabic writing.

name: Ahmed Abou-Auf
bio: Ahmed Abou-Auf is a professor of electronics and communications engineering who joined AUC in 2006. His work focuses on FPGA and ASIC design and signal-processing systems.

name: Noha Abou-Khatwa
bio: Noha Abou-Khatwa earned her PhD in Islamic art and material culture from the University of Toronto. Her work focuses on manuscripts, calligraphy, architecture, and intellectual life in the medieval Muslim world.

name: Nidaa Aboulhosn
bio: Nidaa Aboulhosn is a Lebanese-American visual artist and assistant professor at AUC. Her work spans photography, drawing, time-based media, bookmaking, perception, light, sound, and visual language.

name: Mohamed Abou-Zeid
bio: Mohamed Abou-Zeid earned his PhD from the University of Kansas before joining AUC in 1997. His work spans construction engineering, academic integrity, accreditation, and university governance.

name: Amr Adly
bio: Amr Adly earned his PhD in political economy from the European University Institute before joining AUC. His work focuses on political economy, economic sociology, development, and Middle East studies.

name: Firas Al-Atraqchi
bio: Firas Al-Atraqchi is a Canadian journalist and editor who has covered the Middle East and North America since 1992. His work focuses on journalism, editing, global affairs, and student media.

name: Ramy Aly
bio: Ramy Aly earned his PhD in social anthropology from the University of Sussex before joining AUC in 2013. His work focuses on Arab diasporas, identity, ethics, revolution, and racial formations in Egypt.

name: Sherif Aly
bio: Sherif Aly earned his doctorate from George Washington University. His work focuses on mobile and pervasive computing, academic program development, accreditation, and technology governance.

name: Hassanein Amer
bio: Hassanein Amer earned his MSc and PhD in electrical engineering from Stanford University. His work focuses on circuit reliability, VLSI fault modeling, networked control systems, and wireless communications.

name: Maysa Ayoub
department: Center for Migration and Refugee Studies

name: Rodrigo Brum
bio: Rodrigo Brum holds an MA in philosophy and an MFA in film and new media. His work focuses on filmmaking, media installation, speculative design, and documentary production.

name: Hatem Tallima
bio: Hatem Tallima earned his PhD in biochemistry from Cairo University before joining AUC. His work focuses on medicinal chemistry, drug development, vaccines, tropical diseases, and cancer research.

name: Ismaeel Tharwat
bio: Ismaeel Tharwat earned his PhD in economics from Paris-Saclay University before joining AUC. His work focuses on innovation, trade, development, entrepreneurship, and sports economics.

name: Ahmed Tolba
bio: Ahmed Tolba earned his PhD from George Washington University before joining AUC. His work focuses on branding, innovation, online marketing, social marketing, and entrepreneurship.

name: Alessandro Topa
bio: Alessandro Topa earned his PhD in philosophy from the University of Bonn before joining AUC in 2009. His work focuses on Kant, Peirce, semiotics, logic, and practical philosophy.

name: Shahira Yacout
bio: Shahira Yacout earned her MA in teaching Arabic as a foreign language from AUC. Her work focuses on Arabic instruction, curriculum development, assessment, and immersion programs.

name: Mostafa Youssef
bio: Mostafa Youssef earned his PhD from MIT before joining AUC in 2017. His work focuses on computational nuclear materials and ceramic thermodynamics.

name: Moustafa Youssef
bio: Moustafa Youssef is a professor and founder of Egypt’s Wireless Research Center of Excellence. His work focuses on wireless networks, mobile computing, positioning, pervasive computing, and network security.

name: Noha Youssef
bio: Noha Youssef earned her PhD from the London School of Economics before joining AUC in 2012. She previously worked at LSE as a research associate and teaching fellow.

name: Angie Zaher
bio: Angie Abdel Zaher earned her PhD in accounting from Florida International University before joining AUC. Her work focuses on corporate governance, finance, and accounting education.

name: Nour Zaki
bio: Nour Zaki is an assistant professor of developmental psychology and director of AUC’s Attachment Lab. Her work focuses on childhood attachment, adult development, and intergenerational relationships.

name: Hassan Zaky
bio: Hassan Zaky earned his PhD from Johns Hopkins University before joining AUC. His work focuses on demography, population health, fertility, surveys, and health policy.
